correctness.rationale: TARGET route: independently replayed inputs/artifacts/verify.py -> VERIFY_OK (190 spanned lines, 180 ordinary, 10 rich). Cyclotomic arithmetic is correct: phi_20 minimal polynomial z^8-z^6+z^4-z^2+1, top-down reduction z^n=z^{n-2}-z^{n-4}+z^{n-6}-z^{n-8}, conjugation as zeta->zeta^-1, collinearity via exact vanishing of (a-b)conj(a-c)-conj(a-b)(a-c). All C(21,3)=1330 triples tested yielding exactly the 10 claimed antipodal through-center triples; union-find grouping of 210 pairs plus full re-verification of each line is sound. Pair-count identity closes: 10 rich x3 pairs=30 plus 180 ordinary=210. Type census 40 II + 100 IO + 40 OO + 5+5 diameters is internally consistent (C(10,2)-5=40 each side; all 20 center pairs absorbed in rich lines). Degree-4 support polynomial Q=(x^2+y^2-1)(x^2+y^2-4) claim (vanishes on 20/21 points) is trivially true and honestly scoped as instance ledger, not a general partitioning theorem.

originality.rationale: TARGET route audited normally. Fused literature search over literal, equivalent/dual, and broader-coverage forms plus direct fetch of Green-Tao arXiv:1208.4714, MathWorld Ordinary Line, and orchard sources finds no prior ledger for the pinned D21 family (10 unit-circle points at 2k*pi/10, 10 radius-2 points offset by pi/10, plus origin) and no statement of exactly 180 ordinary lines with 40/100/40 II/IO/OO split and 10 antipodal diameters. Green-Tao proves n/2 ordinary lines only for large n with extremals on cubics/one-circle families and its structure theorem does not compute fixed-n=21 two-circle inter-circle collinearities. Csima-Sawyer 6n/13 gives only ~9.7 (at most 10 after ceiling) at n=21, so neither the 11-line threshold nor the 180 exact count is mechanically implied. No table or database (OEIS/MathWorld/orchard records) tabulates this instance.

value.rationale: TARGET route: positive resolution proving at least 11 via exact count 180 with classified types. Object and invariant were motivated before computation as the canonical symmetric two-component analogue testing Dirac-Motzkin stability off the cubic/one-circle model, with threshold ceil(21/2)=11 versus Csima-Sawyer floor ~9. Exact invariant (180 ordinary with 40 II, 100 IO, 40 OO and 10 named antipodal diameters) was not known or mechanically implied and is presented as a typed, replayable reference ledger usable for orchard-duality and multi-component partitioning benchmarks. This is not a textbook restatement, mere parameter substitution, tiny unmotivated gain, or unexplained enumeration; the large margin over 11 does not make it vacuous. Per STANDARD an exact invariant of a motivated natural object needs no new general theorem.
